title: The Charter’s nineteen kinds of exempt job
question: Which City jobs does the Charter exempt from competitive civil-service hiring, and which carry a cap or a time limit?
finding: Charter section 10.104 lists 19 categories of exempt position. Categories 1 to 12 (Mayor’s and City Administrator’s policy staff, elected officers’ chief deputies, department heads and deputies, one secretary per commission, and others) share one overall cap: their proportion of full-time staff may not exceed the 1 July 1994 level. Categories 16 (temporary and seasonal, half-time a year), 17 (substitutes, two years) and 18 (special projects, three years) need Civil Service Commission approval and cannot be renewed. The section was last amended by Proposition C, approved 11/5/2024.
how: The numbered list in section 10.104 of the Charter, read from the full-text export; each quotation is the first 25 words of the category and is checked against the text.
limits: The cap on categories 1 to 12 is a single citywide proportion, so no one department can be said to exceed it from the payroll. Category 13 (attorneys, physicians and others) and 14 (named posts) have no cap or time limit. The Charter itself creates these exempt posts.
